[[P2 Laboratory]] }} '''Flying Type''' (Japanese: '''VSゲノセクトII''' ''VS Genesect II''), titled '''VS Genesect II''' in the [[Shogakukan Asia]] translation, is the 527th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the third chapter of the {{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}. It is subtitled '''Genesect II''' (Japanese: '''フライング・インセクト''' ''Flying Insect'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Flying Type''' in the Shogakukan Asia translation. ==Plot== {{Incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * {{adv|Blake}} attacks the flying saucer and reveals it to be a Pokémon named {{TP|Blake|Genesect}}. * Blake and {{adv|Looker}} learn the creator of {{p|Genesect}} is [[Colress]], who disguised himself as Hood Man two years ago. * Blake realizes that Colress is controlling Genesect through a machine, which means it is still technically {{pkmn2|wild}}, and prepares to catch it. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Blake}} * {{adv|Looker}} * [[Colress]] * {{adv|Magician}} (video) * Townspeople ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Dewott}} ({{OP|Blake|Dewott}}) * {{p|Croagunk}} ({{OP|Looker|Croagunk}}) * {{p|Corphish}} ({{adv|Magician}}'s) * {{p|Misdreavus}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Woobat}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Genesect}} (later {{OP|Blake|Genesect}}) * {{p|Scolipede}} (flashback) * {{p|Pidove}} (×3) {{-}} {{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS526 |prevtitle=Mr. Perfect |nextcode=PS528 |nexttitle=Innocent Scientist |series=Black 2 & White 2 |colorscheme=Unova2}} {{Project Manga notice}} [[de:VS.
